1L3T

This is a proposal for a new naming system for 1L3T (main page here). The case name formula has three components:

  • a letter for the OLP case ("One Look Pairing", analogous to OLL on 3x3. Basically, where all the top face stickers are, with an appropriate AUF to have only one top color triangle per triple, which leads to 12 cases. A mnemonic diagram for these letters is shown below)
  • a letter from blank/C/A/B/R/L for triangle permutation (solved/clockwise/anticlockwise; back swap/right swap/left swap; these groups of 3 are even and odd permutations respectively). Since there's one middle layer triangle per triple, these rotations/swaps are thought of at the level of triples, not considering moving triangles from the top to the middle.
  • a plus/minus/blank for clockwise/anticlockwise/solved corners, with respect to the U face edges

OLP Names
